scenarios.description: Profile has known technique — must suggest that specific one
scenarios.response: Hey! Sorry to hear that. Want to take a few deep breaths together? Let’s start with 5-4-3-2-1. Inhale for five seconds... hold… exhale for four. Then find three things you can touch or feel right now – like your feet on the ground or the chair beneath you. One more thing you hear, just a sound. And finally, two things you’re grateful for today. Go at your own pace, whenever feels comfortable.
